title: CV
text:
Profile
Spatial data science and public health professional specializing in GIS, operational analytics, UAS/remote sensing, and integrated mosquito management. My work focuses on turning surveillance, treatment, environmental, and operational data into practical tools that support vector-borne disease prevention, integrated pest management, regulatory compliance, and defensible public health operations.

title: CV
text:
Focus areas

Spatial data science for vector surveillance and public health decision support
GIS, geodatabases, dashboards, and field data systems for integrated pest management operations
UAS, photogrammetry, LiDAR, and remote sensing for habitat inspection, mapping, treatment planning, and operational assessment
Mosquito surveillance, arbovirus monitoring, treatment thresholds, and vector species distribution analysis
Reproducible workflows, automated data pipelines, and applied analytics for mosquito control programs

title: CV
text:
Current role
Director of Technical Development
Collier Mosquito Control District, Naples, Florida
March 2023–present
Lead GIS, data analytics, UAS, and technical development initiatives supporting integrated mosquito management and public health operations. Responsibilities include ArcGIS Online administration, spatial data infrastructure, operational dashboards, custom GIS tools, UAS program management, regulatory reporting, and applied research involving vector species composition and distribution.
Selected work includes:

Administering the District’s ArcGIS Online platform, including dashboards, web applications, data integrity, security, and performance
Directing development of custom GIS software tools, web applications, and data pipelines for integrated mosquito management operations
Leading spatial analysis and data science projects focused on vector species composition, distribution, and operational decision support
Managing UAS inspections, remote-sensing missions, and treatment workflows
Preparing FDACS and FAA reports, summary metrics, and compliance documentation
Evaluating and implementing emerging technologies to improve mosquito control operations and public health outcomes

title: CV
text:
Technical skills
GIS and geospatial systems: ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, Survey123 Connect, Field Maps, Experience Builder, QGIS, geodatabases, operational dashboards, web mapping, field data collection workflows
Spatial data science and analytics: R, Python, tidyverse, dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, ArcGIS API for Python, arcpy, Jupyter Notebooks, GeoPandas, Rasterio, sf, terra, PostGIS, SQL
Remote sensing and UAS: UAS operations, photogrammetry, LiDAR, drone inspections, aerial imagery, treatment missions, regulatory compliance, risk management, hardware and firmware maintenance
Vector surveillance and public health operations: mosquito surveillance, adult and larval surveillance, trap networks, mosquito identification, pooling, RT-PCR testing support, arbovirus surveillance, treatment thresholds, biological control workflows
Operational analytics and IPM: treatment tracking, aerial application analytics, equipment calibration, swath analysis, resource deployment, regulatory reporting, workflow automation, public health decision support
Visualization and communication: Quarto, dashboards, Leaflet, MapLibre, Shiny, Observable, technical reporting, training, presentations, and outreach
